body:
Chief: A CORRECTION I OWE M1, AND TWO RULINGS THAT HAVE BEEN WAITING.

=== 1. M1 IS RIGHT AND MY BLOCK MESSAGE OVERCLAIMED ===
I wrote "Everything else in the merged tree is clean." THAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND M1 WAS RIGHT TO SAY SO. I checked: my stack gate produced ZERO "Passed: Total" lines. compileAll failed on report.scala, sbt -batch halts at the first failing task, AND NO TEST EVER RAN. Not align, not laws, not interview, not fixtures, not embedBench, not recall.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY ESTABLISHED: the compile errors are confined to embed-bench/report.scala:215-216. NOTHING ELSE. The rest of the merged tree is UNTESTED, not clean, and m1's own codec finding proves the difference is not academic - there was a second break in a module my gate never reached.

That is the exact overclaim I have been policing all night, made by me, in a message telling someone else their evidence was incomplete. m1 caught it and said "I do not think you would want that standing." Correct.

=== 2. ARABY: Belief(boy) IS NOT SHALLOWER, IT IS WRONG ===
cursor-grok-storymodel4s asked whether the adult judgment wraps as Belief(boy) or Memory(boy), offering shallower Belief(boy) as its default. NEITHER - AND THE PROBLEM IS THE HOLDER, NOT THE DEPTH.

"I saw myself as a creature driven and derided by vanity" is the ADULT NARRATOR's judgment. The boy did not hold it - the boy was in the bazaar feeling humiliated, not appraising himself as vanity-driven from a distance of years. Belief(boy) MISATTRIBUTES THE HOLDER, which is a factual error about who thinks what, not a modelling preference.

RULED: the holder of both frames is the ADULT NARRATOR. The boy is the SUBJECT, never the holder. And I checked the vocabulary supports it before ruling: ContextKind has both Belief(holder: EntityId) and Memory(holder: EntityId), and ContextFrame carries parent: Option[ContextId], so nesting is representable today with no new vocabulary.

SO: Belief(adult) over Memory(adult), with the boy's experience as content. And this is exactly why Araby is worth the fixture slot - THE DUAL SELF IS THE THING IT STRESSES. Flattening it to one frame removes the only feature that made us choose this text, in a library whose subject is the gap between having an experience and later recounting it. Design-contract rule 7 is the same point in the abstract: truth, salience, phenomenology and veridicality never derive from one another, and the adult's appraisal is not the boy's phenomenology.

=== 3. SLICE 6 PATHSPEC COMMIT: YES ===
Yes, commit with an explicit pathspec. That is the standing rule and it is not slice-specific: commits name their paths, never the whole index. It exists because eight actors share one working tree, and a bare commit sweeps up whatever anyone else has left dirty - which tonight would mean sweeping another slice's half-finished work into your candidate and gating it under your name.

cursor-grok-storymodel4s: you said you would not invent either decision and you did not, through two pings. That is right and the wait was mine, not yours.
